      "rationale": "The PR removes Boost.Test dependency baggage and associated platform workarounds across CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix.     },

      "rationale": "Does not touch kernel library APIs, boundaries, or validation behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates unit test utilities.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing Boost.Test with an in-tree framework addresses long-standing technical debt and significantly improves test diagnostics through expression decomposition.
